title: Vee Password Input
summary: Added a VeePasswordInput component with a show/hide toggle, an optional strength bar, and an optional requirements checklist.
body: - [**VeePasswordInput**](/forms/veepasswordinput): A Vee-Validate password field with a show/hide toggle, an optional strength bar (`show-strength`), and an optional requirements checklist (`show-requirements`). Choose which criteria to check via the `requirements` prop using built-in keys (`length`, `special`, `number`, `lowercase`, `uppercase`) or your own `{ text, test }` objects, and set the length threshold with `min-length`. The bar scales to the criteria you pass. Install it with `ui-thing@latest add vee-password-input`. Check out the documentation [here](/forms/veepasswordinput).
